import pager
def fits(message, limit):
    out = pager.truncate(message, limit)
    size = len(out.encode('utf-8'))
    if len(message.encode('utf-8')) <= limit:
        return out == message
    kept = out[:-1]
    longer = message[: len(kept) + 1] + '…'
    return (
        size <= limit and out.endswith('…') and message.startswith(kept)
        and len(longer.encode('utf-8')) > limit
    )
